capabilities: Add a tag to all notes in a folder via right-click
Add a tag to multiple notes selected with Shift+Mouse
Write tags inline at the bottom of notes or as a YAML property
Check for duplicate tags when writing YAML properties
disambiguation: Not a tag manager or tag browser; it only bulk-appends a tag to many notes at once.
extras: The author states the plugin will remain functional but is focusing development on obsidian-multi-properties, which serves similar functionality; Multi Tag remains the option for inline tags.
problem: Obsidian tags are added one note at a time, so tagging many notes at once means opening and editing each file manually.

relations.evidence: I will be focusing on obsidian-multi-properties instead, which serves very similar functionality

summary: Bulk-tagging tool that adds a tag to every note in a selected folder or multi-selection, writing it inline or as a YAML property.
